resultJson.title: Fix websocket and JSON stream encoding bugs, add test suites
resultJson.body:
Work for #283.

- **Websocket client:** `BackendClientLive` now changes the base URL scheme from `http` to `ws` and from `https` to `wss` before opening websocket connections. The JVM HttpClient rejects `http` and `https` schemes for websockets.
- **JSON streams:** `toJsonArrayStream` and `toJsonLinesStream` used to turn each char into a byte with `_.toByte`, which broke non-ASCII text. They now use a UTF-8 encoder that keeps a surrogate pair together when it is split across two chunks. The wrapper variant now uses UTF-8 too and emits `}` as a byte.
- **Tests:** added ZIO Test to the core, shared, client, server, laminar and exampleServer modules, with specs for each, and removed the empty munit placeholder. `EndToEndSpec` in `examples/server` starts the example server on a free port and calls it through the library client. It covers plain, secured, streaming and websocket endpoints and includes a fake httpbin, so it needs no network access.
- **CI:** now runs `sbt test exampleServer/test`. `exampleServer` is not part of the root aggregate, so it has to be listed on its own.

Also includes `.orca/` settings and run files, plus whitespace and formatting changes in `ZIOSttpBackendLive` and `FetchBackendClient`.

Closes #283
